title: Chess of the Seven Planets
body: Long ago in medieval Spain, King Alfonso the Wise wrote a book about his favorite games. One of the strangest was a special kind of chess based on outer space. Players would roll dice to move pieces shaped like the seven known planets, including Mars, Venus, and the Moon!

variants.lucy: Hundreds of years ago in Spain, a clever king wrote down a beautiful game in his giant book. The board represented the quiet night sky, with delicate pieces carved to look like the moon and glowing planets. Instead of regular chess, players guided these heavenly shapes on a journey through the stars.
variants.luca: Imagine tossing dice to launch Mars and Venus into a cosmic battle! A Spanish king designed this high-energy game to bring the solar system right onto his table. You got to command seven legendary celestial bodies and blast your way across the board.
variants.cn: 几百年前的西班牙，有一位聪明的国王在他的大书里记下了一种美丽的游戏。棋盘代表着安静的夜空，精巧的棋子被雕成月亮和闪闪发光的行星的模样。这可不是普通的国际象棋——玩的人要带着这些天上的小家伙，在星星之间走一场奇妙的旅行。

source.author: Alfonso X (Castilla), ed. Raúl Orellana Calderón
